title: THE GUN READS
why: His order of 2026-10-12, make them all look better. The barrel of every gun was a pale blue grey, the lightest thing on it, so at raid size the weapon read as a pale slab. Receiver and barrel are dark gunmetal now with a lit top edge, the underside in shade, a muzzle block on the end and a darker magazine, and the gun hand now holds the grip at the end of the sleeve while the other hand rides the handguard: two hands on the gun. Every gun family keeps its own shape and the tier colour stays on the top edge.
now: Guns are dark gunmetal with a lit edge and a muzzle block, held in two hands.

edits.replacement: if(_mag){ wc.fillStyle='#2a2f35'; wc.fillRect(6+ext,1.4,2.8,4.2); wc.fillStyle='#59626b'; wc.fillRect(6+ext,1.4,0.7,4.2); }   // v23.xx (spr17): a dark magazine, lit on its leading edge

if(_rc){ wc.fillStyle=_rc; wc.fillRect(7+ext,-2.3,Math.max(3,_L-5),0.9); }
  wc.fillStyle=_HANDC; wc.fillRect(5.4+ext,-1.5,2.4,3.0);   // v23.xx (spr17): the gun hand on the grip, at the end of the sleeve
